note: Every entry is a transcription made by the studio. The basis field is the studio's original wording; read it with the label in the recipe: an entry without a published raw file is REPORTED, whatever its basis says.
recipe: Omission blindness: a required-elements gate and lint for campaign copy

receipts.value: 58 post blocks (X 8, Bluesky 15, Threads 7, Facebook 7, Instagram 7, TikTok 7, LinkedIn 7); 21 block-severity findings: TikTok no hashtags x7, LinkedIn no hashtags x7, Instagram no alt text x7
receipts.caveat: The tool's own output on one sheet that is not published. The report is in lint-report.public.json beside this file, with one field (the local sheet path) redacted.

receipts.claim: How the miss passed four stages
receipts.value: A LinkedIn draft with zero hashtags passed author, reader, approver and poster; a person caught it at the posting step. Each stage checked for defects in the text; none checked that required elements were present
receipts.caveat: From the studio's own retro; the sheet and the retro are not published.

receipts.value: Command shape: python -I -B req_lint_sheet.py --sheet <sheet.md> --report <report.json>. 10 tests passed, including 3 mutation kills
receipts.caveat: Test file and script are not published.

receipts.claim: First run on the real sheet
receipts.value: The lint had passed 35 of 35 of its tests, but its first run on the real sheet could not parse it (90 UNSPECIFIED results). A second round fixed the parser and reproduced the 21 findings
receipts.caveat: From studio decision records of 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21.

receipts.claim: The same class in merchandise review
receipts.value: A reader passed 21 of 26 rendered images (5 FIX, 0 FAIL) while none was print-ready: 1,024 px is 3.4 in at 300 PPI (1024 / 300 = 3.41), and none carried the brand wordmark
receipts.caveat: One AI reader; images not published. Pixel arithmetic is derived.

receipts.value: The lint is not wired into the live posting step; the poster is told to run the diff before typing, but no hook blocks a post when the lint fails
receipts.caveat: Read from the retro's 'Remaining gap' paragraph.

receipts.claim: What this recipe does not show
receipts.value: How often the omission happens; whether the gate lowers it; the lint's false-positive rate on other sheets
receipts.caveat: No baseline of misses per 100 blocks exists.
